title: Pan-Seared Italian Salmon
description: A simple yet flavorful Italian-inspired dish featuring pan-seared salmon, perfect for a weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: Flaky sea salt
ingredients.notes: Use a light hand when seasoning

ingredients.name: Extra virgin olive oil
ingredients.notes: Choose a high-quality oil for the best flavor

ingredients.name: Lemon wedges
ingredients.notes: Serve alongside the salmon for a burst of citrus

instructions: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Season the salmon fillet with flaky sea salt and black pepper.
Add the olive oil to the preheated skillet and swirl to coat the bottom.
Sear the salmon fillet for 3-4 minutes on the first side, or until it develops a golden-brown crust.
Flip the salmon over and cook for an additional 3-4 minutes, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 145°F.
Remove the salmon from the skillet and serve immediately with a squeeze of lemon juice.
Serve with your choice of sides, such as roasted vegetables or a simple green salad.
Garnish with additional lemon wedges, if desired.
